title: Rabbi Yehudah ben Dama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Midrash Eleh Ezkerah, printed in Beit HaMidrash, volume 2, counts him among the Ten Martyrs and says he was killed on the eve of Shavuot. Hyman says the poem for the Yom Kippur Musaf service was based on this midrash. Nachalat Avot proposes identifying him with Rabbi Yehudah ben Tema.

notes.text: Nachalat Avot’s connection with Yehudah ben Tema is a proposed identification. The martyrdom and piyyut statements remain Hyman’s account.
The consulted digital Eleh Ezkerah names Yehudah ben Dama and gives the eve of Shavuot. The precise Beit HaMidrash edition and the Nachalat Avot passage were not independently checked.
